read.summary: This is a DECISION (DECYZJA) from the Małopolska Voivode granting a temporary residence permit for the purpose of scientific research until 29.11.2028. It was issued after the foreigner completed formal deficiencies and submitted required documents. You have 14 days from delivery to appeal if you disagree.

If you disagree with the decision, file an appeal to the Head of the Office for Foreigners through the Voivode within that time
Wait for notification that your residence card is ready and collect it in person
